items.title: September Investor Update
items.summary: In a month when broader markets corrected, with the NSE 500 down 2.0% and the Nifty Midcap down 2.9%, Ironclad PMS declined just 0.2%. For YTD 2025, the portfolio has compounded 16.5%, delivering 9.1% alpha over the NSE 500 and reinforcing the strength of our investment framework.

items.title: August Investor Update
items.summary: Markets corrected in July (NSE 500 down 3.0%), while our portfolio declined only 1.1%, continuing to deliver alpha in a risk-off environment. The portfolio remains focused on three themes, financials, brands and tech products, with the aim of compounding through cycles. In this note:
points: Why we have fully exited our limited exposure to IT services
Why product-based tech firms stand to gain from AI
Our view on the 25% US tariffs on Indian exports
Continued strength in financials and branded consumer names

items.title: June Investor Update
items.summary: March 2025 marked a strong rebound from earlier drawdowns, with the Nifty 500 gaining 7.3% and Ironclad delivering 6.2% for the month. Over the three months combined, Ironclad returned 7.4%, against 1.9% for the Nifty 500 and 0.5% for the Nifty Midcap, reflecting our focus on limiting downside risk through stock selection and disciplined risk management.

items.title: April Investor Update
items.summary: Over the past three months combined, Ironclad returned 7.4%, against 1.9% for the Nifty 500 and 0.5% for the Nifty Midcap. In March 2025 the Nifty 500 rebounded 7.3% and Ironclad delivered 6.2%. This update also discusses two of our portfolio holdings: Abbott India and Prudent Corporate.

items.title: March Investor Update
items.summary: February 2025 saw significant drawdowns, with the Nifty 500 down 7.9%; Ironclad declined 3.9%, well ahead of the broader market. This followed a 5.14% gain in January 2025, when we held cash for most of the month and began deploying only towards its end.
